package common

import chisel3._
import chisel3.util._

// Extended FIFO with flush capability and element-count output
class FifoXe[T <: Data](gen: T, depth: Int) extends Module {
  val io = IO(new Bundle {
    val enq   = Flipped(Decoupled(gen))
    val deq   = Decoupled(gen)
    val flush = Input(Bool())
    val count = Output(UInt(log2Ceil(depth + 1).W))
  })

  val q = Module(new Queue(gen, depth, hasFlush = true))
  q.io.enq        <> io.enq
  io.deq          <> q.io.deq
  q.io.flush.get  := io.flush
  io.count        := q.io.count
}
